value: **Embodied & Participatory Modeling**: Leverages embodied, mixed-reality, or physical role-play activities to ground learners' sense-making and computational modeling of complex systems. Evidence: "We apply the measures to a small group of 5th-6th grade students engaging in computer supported, collaborative learning (CSCL) embodied science modeling activities."
